methods.mouser: Mouser Search API (search/partnumber). TWO searches per part: `Exact` on the authoritative MPN, then `None` on the suffix-stripped MPN — one part has several catalog records and they disagree. CITED.
methods.digikey: PRODUCT PAGE read by a human and recorded in 01_docs/sourcing/manual_quotes.yaml. No API key available (OAuth client credentials not provided). CITED from a product page; a search snippet is REFUSED.
methods.amazon: Direct product links only, hand-recorded. No usable API (PA-API needs an affiliate account). ESTIMATED, always — stock and price are volatile and unverifiable.
